sections.title: PRODUCT DESCRIPTION
sections.textPreview:
Available Sizes
• 2 – 20"/50 – 500 mm
Pipe Material
• Designed specifically for use on 2507, Zeron 100, 2205, 254SMO and AL6XN Stainless Steel Pipe.
Maximum Working Pressure
• Accommodates pressures ranging from full vacuum (29.9 in Hg/760 mm Hg) up to 1200psi (8274 kPa).
• Working pressure dependent on wall thickness and size of pipe (see section 5.0 for Performance).
Operating Temperature
• Dependent on gasket selection from section 3.0.
Application
• Provides a rigid pipe joint.
• Joins pipe and Victaulic StrengThin™ fittings, valves and accessories.
Pipe Preparation
• Exclusively for use with fittings, valves, accessories and pipe which feature ends formed with the Victaulic
StrengThin™ groove profile (see section 7.0 for Reference Materials).

sections.textPreview:

property damage.
